bounds.quote: Set the bar across the front shoulders with a full grip and the forearms close to vertical.
bounds.bound: Bar starts across the front shoulders (neck x + 1.5 < bar x <= neck x + 4.0, |bar y - neck y| <= 1.5) with both forearms within 10 degrees of vertical, and no elbow closes past 30 degrees (internal) with the wrist at least 3.84 (upper-arm plus forearm painted radii) from the upper-arm centreline at every 33 ms tick

bounds.quote: Press close past the face, move the head through to a tall lockout, and lower along the same path.
bounds.bound: At every 33 ms tick the head clears the bar in 3D by >= BODY.hr + 0.8; the closest point of the drawn bar segment (between its painted ends, not its midpoint) clears the head ring's painted outer edge (r + strokeWidth / 2) by >= 0.8; the bar is seen end on at every tick, its plate painted after the head, and its painted sleeve end clear of the head ring

bounds.quote: Stand with balanced feet and brace before the bar leaves the shoulders.
bounds.bound: Centre of mass of body (Winter segment fractions) plus a load of 0 or 0.25 body mass per hand stays over the painted feet at every 33 ms tick, and the bar stays within 2.0 of mid-foot and between ankle and toe

bounds.quote: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
bounds.bound: Dumbbells start within 2.0 of shoulder height; no elbow closes past 30 degrees and the wrist stays >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline at every 33 ms tick
Both elbows start more than 5.0 in front of their shoulders

bounds.quote: Press up while rotating your palms to face forward at the top.
bounds.bound: Close-up at the start (palms toward you) draws the back of the hand as a darker (textMid) block painted over the handle with four knuckles above it and no fingers in front; at the top (palms forward) a light (textHi) palm painted behind the handle with four fingers crossing it; the thumb is on opposite sides

bounds.quote: Set a low pulley and bring the handle to shoulder height, standing tall.
bounds.bound: Handle starts within 2.0 of shoulder height and presses to >= 176 degrees; no elbow closes past 30 degrees with the wrist >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline; body centre of mass over the painted feet

bounds.quote: Clean two kettlebells to the shoulders and stand tall with the palms facing in.
bounds.bound: Both bells within 2.0 of shoulder height with palmYaw 90 at the rack; no elbow closes past 30 degrees with the wrist >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline; centre of mass with 0 or 0.25 body mass per hand over the painted feet at every 33 ms tick

bounds.quote: bring one dumbbell to shoulder height with the palm facing forward
bounds.bound: Dumbbell starts within 2.0 of shoulder height; no elbow closes past 30 degrees with the wrist >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline at every 33 ms tick

bounds.quote: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and stand tall with the palm facing in.
bounds.bound: Bell starts within 2.0 of shoulder height with palmYaw 90; no elbow closes past 30 degrees with the wrist >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline at every 33 ms tick

bounds.quote: Clean two kettlebells to the shoulders and stand tall.
bounds.bound: No elbow closes past 30 degrees with the wrist >= 3.84 from the upper-arm centreline; centre of mass with 0 or 0.25 body mass per hand over the painted feet at every 33 ms tick

bounds.quote: keep alternating for the same number of repetitions on each side
bounds.bound: Equal count of lockout intervals per side over the cycle
